================================================================================
SC-SOFTKW-ARG: `using` as a named-argument name (Scala 2 idiom)
================================================================================

// jackson-module-scala's pervasive `@JsonDeserialize(using = classOf[...])`.
// `using` is a Scala 3 keyword but stays a parameter name in Scala 2 sources.
case class Foo(@JsonDeserialize(using = classOf[MyDeserializer]) myVal: BigDecimal)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (comment)
  (comment)
  (class_definition
    name: (identifier)
    class_parameters: (class_parameters
      (class_parameter
        (annotation
          name: (type_identifier)
          arguments: (arguments
            (assignment_expression
              left: (identifier)
              right: (generic_function
                function: (identifier)
                type_arguments: (type_arguments
                  (type_identifier))))))
        name: (identifier)
        type: (type_identifier)))))

================================================================================
SC-SOFTKW-PARAM: `given` as a parameter name (Scala 2 idiom)
================================================================================

// filodb's WrongNumberArguments names a parameter `given`.
case class WrongNumberArguments(given: Int, expected: Int) extends InvalidFunctionSpec

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (comment)
  (class_definition
    name: (identifier)
    class_parameters: (class_parameters
      (class_parameter
        name: (identifier)
        type: (type_identifier))
      (class_parameter
        name: (identifier)
        type: (type_identifier)))
    extend: (extends_clause
      type: (type_identifier))))

================================================================================
SC-SOFTKW-CTXF: context function type requires `?=>` (sloplint)
================================================================================

def f(x: (using Context) ?=> Int) = x
def g(f: (using Int, String) ?=> Boolean) = f

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (function_definition
    name: (identifier)
    parameters: (parameters
      (parameter
        name: (identifier)
        type: (function_type
          parameter_types: (parameter_types
            type: (type_identifier))
          return_type: (type_identifier))))
    body: (identifier))
  (function_definition
    name: (identifier)
    parameters: (parameters
      (parameter
        name: (identifier)
        type: (function_type
          parameter_types: (parameter_types
            type: (type_identifier)
            type: (type_identifier))
          return_type: (type_identifier))))
    body: (identifier)))

================================================================================
SC-SOFTKW-GIVCALL: `given(1)` after a line-broken operator is a call (sloplint)
================================================================================

val x = 1 +
  given(1)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (val_definition
    pattern: (identifier)
    value: (infix_expression
      left: (integer_literal)
      operator: (operator_identifier)
      right: (call_expression
        function: (identifier)
        arguments: (arguments
          (integer_literal))))))
